purpose: Guardrail for #1463: generic engine changes must not exist solely to imitate one Hospital special case.

capabilities.hospitalNeed: Power, fuses, cardkeys, rescued NPCs, nitrogen valve and opened routes must persist through return traversal and save/load.
capabilities.secondGateAnalogue: Persistent dungeon switches, unlocked shortcuts, town/dungeon world-state and self-state.
capabilities.otherPeCase: Day 3 NYPD changes a familiar hub into a hostile stateful dungeon; Day 5 sewer pump/power routing.
capabilities.preferredLayer: authored events + existing persistent flag/self-state primitives
capabilities.engineChangePolicy: generic_only_if_existing event/state primitives cannot express the transition

capabilities.hospitalNeed: Elevators expose destinations conditionally from power/card/key state.
capabilities.secondGateAnalogue: Multi-floor labyrinth/town transfers and any authored one-to-many destination selector.
capabilities.otherPeCase: Museum and Chrysler Building elevator/floor routing.
capabilities.engineChangePolicy: generic destination-selection primitive only if not expressible as ordinary event choices/transfers

capabilities.hospitalNeed: Autopsy Key, Blue/Green Cardkeys, fuses and Elevator Key gate interactions and may be consumed/retired according to source behavior.
capabilities.secondGateAnalogue: Keys, seals and progression items gating dungeon/town routes.
capabilities.otherPeCase: Day 1 Theater/Rehearse keys; Day 3 Storage/Locker keys.

capabilities.hospitalNeed: Several enemy families must share the same real-time battle semantics while producing different movement, telegraph and status pressure.
capabilities.secondGateAnalogue: Distinct manifestation/enemy families sharing one battle/event vocabulary.
capabilities.otherPeCase: Day 2 Central Park enemy ecology; Day 5 Museum/sewer ecology.
capabilities.engineChangePolicy: new delivery/status primitive must be enemy-agnostic

capabilities.hospitalNeed: Gun rounds must live in a weapon magazine/Bullet Cap and reload from carried ammunition rather than consuming the global pile per shot.
capabilities.otherPeCase: All firearm-heavy PE chapters, especially Days 3–6.
capabilities.preferredLayer: PE project data on generic equipment/resource primitives
capabilities.engineChangePolicy: do not add PE-named engine state. Generalize only if a Second Gate limited-use equipment-resource analogue is identified; otherwise keep composition project-local.

capabilities.hospitalNeed: Tool/Tune-Up and BP can alter carried equipment parameters/effects, influencing the canonical combat economy.
capabilities.otherPeCase: PE equipment loop from Day 2 onward and EX Game.
capabilities.preferredLayer: project data on generic item/equipment mutation primitives
capabilities.engineChangePolicy: keep PE-specific transfer policy project-local; only generic parameter/effect transfer may become an engine primitive after a Second Gate analogue is approved.

capabilities.hospitalNeed: Spiderwoman changes arena mid-fight without becoming an unrelated fake encounter.
capabilities.secondGateAnalogue: Boss phase transitions that preserve one encounter/domain identity while presentation/arena state changes.
capabilities.otherPeCase: Day 1 Alligator body/tail behavior; Day 5 Centipede split; Day 6 Ultimate Being transformations.
capabilities.preferredLayer: battle resolved state + authored presentation/scene transition
capabilities.engineChangePolicy: generic phase/target facts only; no Spiderwoman special cases

capabilities.hospitalNeed: After the rooftop fight, an explicit countdown turns spatial traversal into a failure-capable escape beat.
capabilities.secondGateAnalogue: Timed dungeon hazards or escape/event sequences, if authored.
capabilities.preferredLayer: authored event timer using canonical time/input primitives
capabilities.engineChangePolicy: prefer event composition; engine primitive only if ordinary timers cannot expose deterministic deadline state
